name: app-dark-user-persona-card-board
title: Dark User Persona Board
whatItIs: A dark slate slide titled User Persona with a portrait card of an anime-style traveller, a quote bar, cards for goals with blue checks, a semicircle engagement gauge with dots, needs arrows, and striped interest bars.
whatItMeans: Modular dark cards break a persona into scannable parts, and blue accents tie it to the product.
techniques: Persona portrait card with name overlay
Big quote mark tile leading a quote bar
Dotted gauge for an engagement metric

vocabulary.definition: A fictional user profile summarising goals and needs.
An arc gauge made of dots with one highlighted value.
A bar background striped with diagonal lines.
